scenarios.description: A full snapshot is exactly classified ready and may update both durable tracks.
A scoped update is ready while an unaffected port retains older exact evidence.
A terminal degraded generation advances only classified state and preserves ready history.
Runtime damage on a classified baseline preserves both tracks and requires a compatible full resync.
An active apply with complete pending identity is read-only and polled.
A protected pending inventory failure permits only exact recover-pending.
WAL or contract uncertainty is operator-only and makes no write.
Rollback restored the applied baseline and only a newer full snapshot may become ready.
The narrow empty-baseline exception permits exact inventory-unavailable recovery.
A metadata-free legacy response is accepted only with the complete TXN-028 ready shape.
A complete legacy identity with an unknown authority token is a no-write contract error.
Unknown Status V1 metadata or closed vocabulary is a typed no-write contract error.
A ready label never overrides invalid identity, domain, support, or duplicate-row evidence.
Restart routing follows classified projected IDs while feature-ready history remains unchanged.
